title: Counterfactual replay freezes noise only after legal posterior conditioning
statement: For independent square-integrable C and V~N(0,I_m), target C^T V, controller/final predictor retaining C, at most q unit-ball linear reads with iid N(0,s),s>0, and at most B charged binary controller branches on EVERY path, optimal interactive Bayes risk equals min_(M1,...,M_(2^B)) E_C min_j C^T(I+M_j^T M_j/s)^-1 C. Compact feasible matrices give an attained value, even with noisy repeats, oblique rows and arbitrary legal interleaving. Condition first on C/legal transcript/algorithmic seeds to get conditional Gaussian covariance; only then freeze V/noise/seeds for replay matrices independent of C. Do not reveal physical innovations to predictor. Every C-dependent timing/address/request/termination distinction counts; legal branches totalize within hard budgets. Exact-read analogue uses rank<=q subspace codebooks. Unlimited control gives s E||C||^2/(s+q); B=0 isotropic C with q<=m gives 1-q/[m(1+s)]. Public Z correlated with C needs E_Z R(B,q;law(C|Z)), with V independent of(C,Z); actuator alone without C changes the problem. This is an exact VALUE, not an efficient exponential-codebook compiler, expected-budget theorem or non-Gaussian/nonlinear-residual extension.

requires: Controller and final predictor retain known square-integrable C; V~N(0,I) independent of C and all algorithmic seeds/physical iid N(0,s) innovations,s>0. Unit-ball scalar linear sensing rows; all readout feedback is legal past observations/seeds.

At most q reads and B binary controller branches on EVERY path. Totalize counterfactual branches; charge informative timing,requests,addresses,stopping and metadata. Public correlated context Z requires conditional codebooks and V independent of(C,Z).

Codebook/directions and posterior computations are feasible but not supplied efficiently. Actuator-only predictor without C,non-Gaussian V,nonlinear residual observations,dependent noise or expected budgets require different results.

costs: Codebook may have 2^B entries and exponential storage/search; exact value theorem supplies no cheap compiler or conditional-mean oracle. First-stage information, full return precision, local arithmetic, direction generation and physical aggregate access remain separate.

r=128 theorem: 129 reads, 1408 context/control bits,16-bit final ADC and 165,120-bit local program applying 8,256 weights. Local 20M-bit encoding is an upper bound, not a necessary actuator-state lower bound.

r=64 synthetic calibration pays 2,080 scalar calls with absolute error 1e-7, 4,326,400 feature entries, 8,652,800 target products and 16,640-byte prepared model; deployment 65 reads and 2,080 dense aggregate products. Full-input/direct-target alternatives receive same information and actual noise/cost.
